pooled_mean_abs_gap.note: uses |weighted_mean_sim - mean_sim_post|; the signed mean is near zero by cancellation (positive and negative deviations roughly balance across neurons) and is not informative alone

structural_floor.reason: with exactly one pairwise similarity in the component, the AUC-weighted mean of a single value trivially equals the unweighted mean -- not evidence that weighting doesn't matter

trend_abs_gap_vs_n_surviving.interpretation: gap peaks around n_surviving=3 and declines as survivor count grows further -- opposite of 'weighting matters more at higher N'; no significant monotonic widening trend

within_neuron_paired_comparison.interpretation: controls for neuron identity directly; consistent with the pooled binned trend above

confidence_C_dilution.interpretation: C is a mean over ALL candidate descriptions, so it is mechanically diluted by adding more (typically lower-quality) candidates -- a definitional property of C's formula, not a k effect
